items.name: Amazon ECS
items.description: AWS container orchestration service for deploying, managing, and scaling Docker containers without needing to manage the underlying cluster software.

items.name: Amazon EKS
items.description: Managed service for running Kubernetes clusters on AWS without needing to install and operate the Kubernetes control plane.

items.name: Azure Container Apps
items.description: Serverless hosting service on Azure for running containerized applications and microservices without managing underlying infrastructure or orchestration directly.

items.name: Docker
items.description: Platform for building, packaging, and running applications in lightweight, portable containers that bundle code and dependencies together.

items.name: Docker Compose
items.description: Tool for defining and running multi-container Docker applications using a single YAML configuration file to specify services, networks, and volumes.

items.name: Helm
items.description: Package manager for Kubernetes that uses charts to define, install, and upgrade complex applications and their dependencies.

items.name: Kubernetes
items.description: Open-source platform for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications across clusters of machines.

items.name: Microsoft Hyper-V
items.description: Native hypervisor built into Windows for creating and managing virtual machines, enabling multiple operating systems to run on a single physical host.

items.name: OpenShift
items.description: Enterprise Kubernetes platform from Red Hat that adds developer and operational tooling on top of Kubernetes for building and deploying containerized applications.
